Right margin: two notes beside the Simancha and Brunus paragraphs. Signature "Nn" at the foot.

main_text.l: DE DOCTRINA IE-
SVITARVM.
Liber Quartus.
In hoc Libro eam tantum DOCTRINAM IESVITARVM referam, quae
ipsi & alij Pontifici parricidia Regum ac Principum: item, proditio-
nes, seditiones, periuria, Ligas & coniurationes Subditorum adver-
sus Reges, alios{q} legitimos & a Deo ordinatos Magistratus, Am-
phibologias quoque seu Aequivocationes, ac similia multa appro-
bant, & horum scelerum patrocinium suscipiunt.
CAPVT I.
De parricidiis & abdicationibus
Regum ac Principum, &c.
I.

l.i: PRIMO, docent, pro invalidis & plane nullis haberi
debere Imperatorum, Regum, Principum, aliorumq; Ordinum Constitutiones,
pacta, conventa, capitulationes, fraternitates, concessiones, quibus alia religio, quam moderna Romano-
Catholica indulgetur: Etiamsi juramento confirmata, non
autem a Romano Pontifice approbata sint.

page.notes: Left edge of the scan cuts off the first letters of most lines below the title block (e.g. "uam num. 25.", "ia num. 52.", "rtinere", "ɔ. 3. cap. 15."); these are kept as visible fragments. The side note "In Tract. Tom. XI. part. 2. pag. 181." is partly abbreviated and uncertain, marked by the printed form. Second note "Tract. Tom. XI. pag. 305." is read from a small, faint line. Some words in the Brunus paragraph near the left edge are not fully legible; the reading "ut Ecclesiastica jurisdictio ipsos suspendatur" should be checked against the scan, since "ipsos" may be "eos" or a truncated word.
